```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyr)
```

```{r cars}

# find degree for each plant/poll in each treatment  

allpolls <- unique(pollinators$Genus)
allplants <- unique(pollinators$sp)
allsp <- c(allpolls, allplants)
BP <- unique(pollsSeedsdf$BP)

trtVersions <- data.frame(
  treatment = seedsGrouped$treatment, 
  genSpec = seedsGrouped$genSpec)

bigmat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(plist), ncol = length(allsp), dimnames = list(names(plist), allsp))
for (i in names(plist)) {
  degree <- specieslevel(plist[[i]], level = "both", index = "degree")
  polls1 <- degree$`higher level`
  plants1 <- degree$`lower level`
  bigmat[i,rownames(polls1)] <- unlist(polls1)
  bigmat[i,rownames(plants1)] <- unlist(plants1)
}


# find specialization for each plant/poll in each treatment
dmat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(plist), ncol = length(allsp), dimnames = list(names(plist), allsp))
for (i in names(plist)) {
  d <- specieslevel(plist[[i]], level = "both", index = "d")
  polls1 <- d$`higher level`
  plants1 <- d$`lower level`
  dmat[i,rownames(polls1)] <- unlist(polls1)
  dmat[i,rownames(plants1)] <- unlist(plants1)
}

# convert matrix to df 
ddf <- as.data.frame(dmat)
ddf$genSpec<-substr(rownames(ddf),1,regexpr("_",rownames(ddf))-1)
ddf$treatment <-rownames(ddf)

ddf_long <- ddf %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(treatment, genSpec), names_to = "species", values_to = "specialization")

# join species level df to poll and seeds df 
ddf_long$sp <- ddf_long$species
speciesDF <- seedsGrouped %>%
  inner_join(ddf_long, by = c("genSpec","sp", "treatment")) %>%
  group_by(genSpec) %>%
  mutate(meanSPEC = mean(specialization, na.rm = TRUE))

meanSPEC <- as.data.frame(speciesDF$meanSPEC, speciesDF$genSpec,)
meanH2 <- as.data.frame(WIDEfocalSeeds1$meanH2, WIDEfocalSeeds1$genSpec)
```

visualize species level characteristics: DEGREE 

```{r}

# plot specalization for plants 
ddf_long %>% 
  filter(species %in% allplants)
ggplot(ddf_long, aes(x = specialization, fill = genSpec)) +
  #geom_histogram(alpha = 0.0, position = "identity", bins = 10) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5)

# plot degree for pollinators 
ddf_long %>%
  filter(species %in% allpolls)
ggplot(ddf_long, aes(x = specialization, fill = genSpec)) +
  #geom_histogram(alpha = 0.0, position = "identity", bins = 10) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5)

lm24<- lm(speciesDF$ratio_seedsPerPlant~speciesDF$specialization)
ggplot(speciesDF, aes(x = specialization, y = ratio_seedsPerPlant, col = genSpec)) +
  geom_point() +
   scale_color_paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::ArcticGates") +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
 geom_abline(intercept = coef(lm24)[1], slope = coef(lm24)[2], color = "red") +
 geom_text(aes(x = 0.75, y = 2, label = "p = 0.9642"), color = "red", vjust = -1) +
  labs(x = "Plant Specialization", y = "Seed Output", color = "Treamtment")

```

Join network level to species level


```{r}
allCHAR <- speciesDF %>%
  rename(seedOutput = "ratio_seedsPerPlant") %>%
  inner_join(WIDEfocalSeeds, by = c("treatment", "seedOutput", "sp", "BP", "genSpec"), relationship = "many-to-many")

allCHAR$genSpec <- gsub("genOnly", "Generalists", allCHAR$genSpec)
allCHAR$genSpec <- gsub("specOnly", "Specialists", allCHAR$genSpec)
allCHAR$genSpec <- gsub("genSpec1", "Mix1", allCHAR$genSpec)
allCHAR$genSpec <- gsub("genSpec3", "Mix2", allCHAR$genSpec)
allCHAR$genSpec <- gsub("genSpec4", "Mix3", allCHAR$genSpec)
allCHAR$Overlap <- allCHAR$AVoverlap
allCHAR$SeedOutput <- allCHAR$seedOutput

write.csv(allCHAR, file = "all_levels_characteristics.csv", col.names = FALSE)
write.csv(WIDEfocalSeeds1, file = "Wide_focals.csv", col.names = FALSE)




```
